description: Install dev dependencies and verify the existing project builds and tests pass as a baseline before making changes.
steps: Run `uv sync` in the project root to install all dev dependencies
Run `make lint` and confirm it currently passes (only scoped to src/ telegram_bot/)
Run `make format-check` and confirm it currently passes
Run `uv run pytest tests/contract/ -n auto --dist=worksteal -q --timeout=30` to confirm existing contract tests pass
findings: Baseline verified successfully. uv sync resolved 372 packages (already installed). make lint passes scoped to 'src/ telegram_bot/' only. make format-check passes (260 files formatted). Contract tests: 776 passed, 7 skipped (mini_app extras + cocoindex extras not installed), 3 xfailed (legacy ingestion modules still in use). No pre-existing failures.
